workflow: ce-code-review quick/default path with two harness reviewer specialists

Actionable Findings.finding: Late upload omitted from the visible photo review
Actionable Findings.resolution: Upload completion now renders both checklist and review. A delayed decode smoke scenario showed one reviewed photo before completion, then two visible and attached photos.

Actionable Findings.finding: Keyboard activation could relocate the pin marker
Actionable Findings.resolution: Marker is a non-focusable, aria-hidden span. Browser check confirmed SPAN, tabIndex -1, visible after placement.

Actionable Findings.finding: Attaching a result discarded focus and left it offscreen
Actionable Findings.resolution: New result card receives programmatic focus and scrollIntoView. Browser check after an actual upload confirmed focus remains on result-card.

Actionable Findings.finding: Unparsed deposit was described as a missing line
Actionable Findings.resolution: Present-but-unreadable deposits use an unresolved option and unknown balance; the located source line is preserved. Browser scenario confirmed explicit unresolved-deposit text.

Actionable Findings.finding: Return date ceiling used UTC rather than local calendar
Actionable Findings.resolution: Date ceiling uses local year/month/day. Pacific/Auckland browser check reproduced September 16/17 mismatch, then confirmed both max and local date are September 17.

Actionable Findings.finding: Percentage anywhere in a quote line hid explicit dollar amounts
Actionable Findings.resolution: Only a percent-suffixed amount is rejected. Sales tax (8.25%): $44.39 is included correctly; $538 subtotal produces $582.39 total.

Actionable Findings.finding: Unparsed subtotal was described as a missing line
Actionable Findings.resolution: Separate missing-line and unreadable-amount messages; unreadable subtotal cannot be saved.

Actionable Findings.finding: Initial trade tab and plan highlight were inconsistent
Actionable Findings.resolution: Installer pack initializes the active tab and corresponding plan chip together.

Coverage: Read-only review of tool lifecycle, async ownership, safe rendering, camera/audio cleanup, WebGL behavior, quote arithmetic, scheduling, approvals, receiving and downloadable evidence. Main exercised actual published browser paths and applied all retained findings. No physical-phone or tracked-AR validation claimed.
Verdict: All eight retained findings resolved. Scoped ESLint passes. Project-wide typecheck remains blocked by three unchanged unused React imports outside this work.
